title: Loss-aware pulse sequence optimization for generating photonic Fock states
summary: We investigate the preparation of frequency-tunable photonic Fock states in a hybrid cavity system consisting of a nonlinear medium and a two-level system. Employing a gradient-based optimization approach, we construct multipulse driving protocols that control the system dynamics through pulse amplitudes, phases, and inter-pulse delays. Assuming unitary dynamics, the optimized sequences enable near-deterministic preparation of low-photon-number Fock states.
